gold.title: Gold Tracker
gold.subtitle: Official IBJA benchmark prices, converted from the latest published AM and PM tables into a live-refreshing gold dashboard.
gold.source_note: IBJA publishes gold in rupees per 10 grams. The per-gram number shown here is the exact benchmark derived from that official PM value.

silver.title: Silver Tracker
silver.subtitle: Official IBJA silver 999 benchmarks, with per-gram conversion and a sterling 92.5% purity benchmark derived from the same live IBJA base.
silver.source_note: IBJA publishes silver 999 in rupees per kilogram. Sterling here is a purity-only benchmark, so it is normally lower than 999 silver unless retail premiums or making charges are added.

platinum.title: Platinum Tracker
platinum.subtitle: Official IBJA platinum 999 values, converted to exact per-gram pricing for your live tracker, converter, and profit calculator.
platinum.source_note: IBJA publishes platinum in rupees per 10 grams. The per-gram rate in this dashboard is the exact conversion of the published PM figure.

bitcoin.title: Bitcoin Tracker
bitcoin.subtitle: Live INR bitcoin pricing from CoinGecko so the crypto side of the dashboard refreshes alongside the bullion benchmarks.
bitcoin.source_note: Bitcoin is fetched live in INR from CoinGecko and refreshed by the UI every 10 seconds.
